source.source_state: Exact saved board read only; no re-save or DRC/source change

native_export.stock_models: Installed KiCad 10 stock 3D model library resolved using KICAD10_3DMODEL_DIR
native_export.native_coordinate_convention: Board in XY; +Z component side. Browser GLB reorients its top normal to +Y.

scope: Cross-CAD mechanical inspection of the saved board, fitted stock component bodies and exported conductor/mask/silkscreen shapes. This is not the editable electrical design or manufacturing approval.
component_body_limits: F1 custom fuse footprint has no fitted fuse body; its exported pads remain
JP1 is a bare copper solder jumper, so has no separate fitted body
R14/R15 are do-not-populate and excluded from fitted 3D components; pads remain
Four mounting holes are native board geometry, not fitted component bodies
